changes.description: A weekly training ride from Etowah Park on Tuesdays and Thursdays. As of October 2026 the club updated the route: rides now follow a course through Mills River and Etowah at a variety of paces and distances. It is a training series, not a guided ride, and riders split into groups by pace.
changes.visitor_notes: Registration is encouraged: you get a cancellation email if the ride is called off. If you are not a club member, sign the BRBC waiver first.
